query: INSERT INTO totp_credentials (user_id, encrypted_secret, secret_nonce, confirmed, last_used_step, created_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6) ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET encrypted_secret = EXCLUDED.encrypted_secret, secret_nonce = EXCLUDED.secret_nonce, confirmed = EXCLUDED.confirmed, last_used_step = EXCLUDED.last_used_step
